gap: No result ChatGPT got states that Betta's own charging adapter fits only the Betta SE Plus and Betta Neo ('Not compatible with other Betta models'). So the Betta SE, which ChatGPT presented as the 'simple solar-only option', has no plug-in fallback at all, while the Aiper EcoSurfer S2 ships with a DC charger in the box and the Beatbot iSkim needs a separate $25 add-on adapter.
standout_why: Pages compared: The Hook Up's comparison (thesmarthomehookup.com/test_install/solar-pool-skimmers-beatbot-aiper-betta-vs-generic/), The Hook Up's recommendation page, and robotdoorstep.com/pool/solar-pool-skimmers/ (all three CITED). The Hook Up says only that the Beatbot wall charger is not in the box and costs $25 extra, and that the Betta and the Hook Up's Betta Neo have hubs. It gives no Betta SE vs SE Plus charging pairing. Robotdoorstep says the Aiper has 'Solar plus DC charging' and that the WYBOT F1 DC charger is 'Sold separately', but it gives no price and does not cover Betta. None of these pages states Betta's adapter exclusion, the Aiper's in-box charger, the WYBOT F1 charger price, the Beatbot adapter's stand-alone price, or which Betta bumper-bar kit fits which model. ChatGPT's own answers said the SE needs 'No power cord or wall charging' and the SE Plus has 'optional plug-in backup', but neither said the SE cannot take the adapter at all.
decides: For a shopper who never wants to plug in, the Betta SE is truly solar-only and cannot be upgraded, because Betta's adapter is excluded for it. If they want a fallback for a run of cloudy days, the Betta SE Plus costs $20 more on Betta's store ($389.90 vs $369.90 on 2026-11-17). The Aiper EcoSurfer S2 includes its DC charger. The Beatbot iSkim (ChatGPT's top pick) and the WYBOT F1 need extra chargers ($25 add-on and $19.99). This confirms the Aiper as the low-sun pick and turns 'Betta SE vs SE Plus' into a clear either/or choice.

findings.source_title: Betta SE - Solar-Powered Robotic Pool Skimmer
findings.note: Betta US store, via storecheck. Product text mentions solar only.

findings.label: Charging method and price
findings.value: Solar plus AC adapter: 5 to 6 h in direct sun or 3.5 h on the adapter; 30+ h rated runtime; $389.90 (compare-at $529.90)
findings.source_title: Betta SE Plus - Solar-Powered Robotic Pool Skimmer
findings.note: Betta US store, via storecheck. $20 more than the SE on the same day.
